recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Only revisit if a new Vocab decision asks for machine-readable repeatability metadata for CodeSystem properties.
issue_request: FHIR-25745 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked FHIR-core CodeSystem to clarify that CodeSystem.concept.property can repeat within a concept when the property code is the same and the value differs; the Vocab work group chose a CodeSystem.property comment rather than adding a repeatability flag.
initial_application: Commit 0e7bc53aeea7725b86d61e87a663b341dafe4580, merged by HL7/fhir#1980, added the requested comment to source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml. A pickaxe search for the exact comment finds that Jira-tagged commit as the application point.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists codesystem=CodeSystem in [resources], confirming the inspected StructureDefinition is current build-scope source. The 2022-04-25 Vocab minutes confirm the submitter clarification and the resolved-change-required disposition. Zulip search for the issue key and key terms found no conflicting or clarifying discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because CodeSystem.property already says repeated CodeSystem.concept.property entries may share a CodeSystem.property when CodeSystem.concept.property.code is the same and CodeSystem.concept.property.value differs. Adding a flag or extra narrative would exceed the published resolution.
